reader_summary.headline: With Web3 gathering more momentum than ever before across the entire tech ecosystem.
reader_summary.overview: With Web3 gathering more momentum than ever before across the entire tech ecosystem, what can we learn from the recent past of tech adoption? In this episode from December 2018, author and podcaster Brian McCullough talks with A16Z general partner Chris Dixon about the origins of the internet. They discuss lessons learned, how innovation doesn't always happen in a straight line.

thesis: The episode argues that understanding the history of the internet, from the dot-com era to the iPhone, provides essential pattern recognition for predicting the future of technology. It emphasizes that many ideas considered 'bad' at the time were actually too early, and that learning from past mistakes and cycles is crucial for survival in an industry prone to boom and bust.
